What has been built.

The site itself

  • 15 pages built on Astro (fast, static, cheap to host, easy to update).
  • Fully responsive across desktop, tablet and mobile.
  • Adaptive light / dark nav that swaps the HalfCut logo colour to match whatever section is behind it.
  • Live donation flow via GreenPay / EzyRaise, embedded natively on the Donate page.
  • Live Go HalfCut registration linked out to the EzyRaise campaign URL.
  • Field Notes wired to Sanity CMS so you can publish new content without a developer.
  • Sponsor logos (Ben & Jerry’s, Flow, GreenPay, Macpac, Orchy, Rennie, All Stripped) render on every page.
  • Acknowledgment of Country pinned to the top of every footer.

The signals we send

  • Single lime-green accent used sparingly, never as decoration.
  • No em-dashes, no bullet dots, no decorative flourishes. Every word earns its place.
  • Every headline is a single colour, single weight, black-and-cream discipline.
  • Every "big number" on the site is designed to be defensible (Impact page states this explicitly).
  • Real photography, real people, no stock, no illustration.
  • Sustainable footprint: carbon badge in the footer measures each page’s bytes and CO₂ live.

Timeline to live.

Four working days from today to production. If your feedback comes back before Sunday afternoon we’ll be pushing to halfcut.org on Monday morning.

Landing page

What’s on the page

What we need from you by Sunday.

The site is ready to go live on Monday, but only if a handful of things land in our inbox before then. In priority order:

01 · DNS Access to the halfcut.org DNS records (or your registrar login), so we can point the domain at Vercel. This is the single biggest blocker to Monday.
02 · Numbers Sign-off on every headline metric on the Impact page. If any figure differs from your latest Annual Report, flag it now.
03 · Team Signed-off bios and portrait choices for every board director on the Team page.
04 · Canopy tiers Confirmed tier names, monthly and annual prices, and inclusions for the four business memberships.
05 · Real assets The actual Annual Report PDFs (2021 through 2024–25), and any missing sponsor logos.
06 · Form routing Where the three forms on the site (Heal Country EOI, Yalada Tours EOI, Contact) should route to.
07 · Live URLs Confirm the Go HalfCut EzyRaise URL and the GreenPay donation widget region ID are current.
08 · Anything we’ve missed Every yellow-highlighted question inside the packet needs a one-line answer from you.

Best way to send it back: one reply email with each item numbered against the list above. If it’s easier to jump on a 20-minute call to walk through it, ping me and we’ll book Friday or Monday morning.
